title: Cohortex MCP tool result envelope
description: Wraps every successful tool result (contracts §5). evidence_id is empty when the server returns it; agent-service's evidence ledger fills it. The compact UTF-8 JSON of the whole envelope is at most 4096 bytes (FR-TOOL-6).

evidence_id.description: Empty from the server; 'ev_' + 16 hex characters once recorded by the ledger.

args.description: Validated arguments with schema defaults applied.

source.description: Where the data came from, e.g. 'fleet-api /v1/cohorts/{source}/{model}/afr'.

generated_at.description: UTC time the tool produced this result (RFC 3339).

truncated.description: True when this result is not the whole answer: more pages follow, or the tool's row limit cut the list.

next_page.description: Page index of the following page, or null on the last page.
